name: Chris
source:
A skilled magician and one of the heroines who destroyed Leila's true father Aruzargu. Upset that Tina would rape the helpless newly hatched Leila she makes her take responsibility by raising the young dragon girl properly.

Sweet, kind, and responsible nevertheless she can't help raping Princess type Leila because seeing her troubled face excites even herself.

She can create tentacles and slimes which are an extension of herself and can grow a penis by magic.
